commit-message.description: Commit message for the version commit. Receives the `oakum status --json` document: `awaiting_tag`, `changed`, `coverage`, `hand_set`, `manages_nothing`, `named_unmanaged`, `packages`, `schema_version`, `selection_empty`, `target`, `uncovered`, `unmanaged`, `unresolved_scopes`. A string is inline; `{ file = "path" }` loads a repository-relative file. Templates render; they do not execute (ADR-0006).

conventional-commits.description: When true, commits can feed `generate`, and the plan if change-files is off (ADR-0029).

exclude.description: Exact package names to leave alone after include filtering (ADR-0027).

include.description: Exact package names to manage. Empty means all packages; then exclude removes (ADR-0027).

extra-files.description: Declared version writes outside the package manifest (ADR-0033).

format.description: Document format. v1 ships json only.

key.description: Dotted key path. `{field=value}` selects a unique array element (ADR-0033).

path.description: Leading `/` is repository-root relative; otherwise relative to the package manifest directory.

publish-command.description: Stored publish command for a post-v0 registry slot. Never executed in v0 (ADR-0011 / ADR-0012).

resolves-dependencies-at.description: Declare that this library bundles dependencies into the published artifact. Binaries are derived; `install` is not configurable (ADR-0009).

versioning.description: How a breaking change file moves a version. `zero-major` (default) maps a major file to a minor bump while the package is below 1.0.0, matching SemVer 2.0 §4. `semver` is how a project releases 1.0.0: the next major file produces 1.0.0, and the key is then inert for that package. Override per package under `[packages.<name>]` so one crate can graduate without taking the rest of the workspace with it.

packages.description: Per-package overrides, keyed by the name the manifest declares.

pr-status.description: Pull-request presentation. `none` silences comment and summary; the exit-code gate is not configurable (ADR-0015).

private-packages.description: Opt-in to version and/or tag packages that are not registry-publishable. Axes are independent (ADR-0027).

tag.description: When true, unpublishable packages still receive git tags.

version.description: When true, unpublishable packages still receive version bumps and changelogs.

tag-format.description: Tag oakum writes. Receives `package` and `version`. A string is inline; `{ file = "path" }` loads a repository-relative file. Existing tags are derived, not configured (ADR-0004).

template.description: Changelog template, rendered once per package section. Receives `bump`, `changes`, `date`, `ecosystem`, `notes`, `package`, `repo`, `source`, `target`, `tool_version`, `trigger`, `version`. A string is inline; `{ file = "path" }` loads a repository-relative file. Templates render; they do not execute (ADR-0006).

title.description: Title for the version pull request. Defaults to the version commit's built-in message; a configured `commit-message` does not change it. Where a repository takes its squash subject from the title, that default keeps the subject conventional. Receives the `oakum status --json` document: `awaiting_tag`, `changed`, `coverage`, `hand_set`, `manages_nothing`, `named_unmanaged`, `packages`, `schema_version`, `selection_empty`, `target`, `uncovered`, `unmanaged`, `unresolved_scopes`. A string is inline; `{ file = "path" }` loads a repository-relative file. One template per surface, with conditionals in the body (ADR-0015).

tool-version.description: Deprecated: oakum no longer reads this key, and `oakum upgrade` removes it. The install pin is the version (ADR-0038).

versioning.description: How a breaking change file moves a version. `zero-major` (default) maps a major file to a minor bump while the package is below 1.0.0, matching SemVer 2.0 §4. `semver` is how a project releases 1.0.0: the next major file produces 1.0.0, and the key is then inert for that package. Override per package under `[packages.<name>]` so one crate can graduate without taking the rest of the workspace with it.
